claims.A9: ruff banned-api matches the literal module string, so a ban on aminx.X silently stops firing once code imports molxmpnn.X.

prereg.question: If the import-boundary bans in pyproject.toml are left naming aminx.* after the rename, does ruff warn, fail, or stay silent? (Re-run of S7, whose probe passed an invalid --isolated + --config combination and measured nothing.)
prereg.expect_if_true: before_rename.py (positive control) reports one TID251 violation and exit=1; after_rename.py reports nothing and exit=0 (silent loss of enforcement).
prereg.expect_if_false: after_rename.py is flagged or ruff errors about the unmatched ban (the rename would be self-announcing and the dead-guard gate is unnecessary), or the positive control is not flagged (the probe is invalid).
